summary: This note describes Born a Lion, the debut album by the Canadian rock band Danko Jones. It notes that the album entered the Canadian Albums Chart at number 51.
one_line: Born a Lion is the 1996 debut album of Canadian rock band Danko Jones, which debuted at #51 on the Canadian Albums Chart.
